quarterly_data.signal: KLA's 10-K: backlog, primarily sales orders where written customer requests have been received, increased from $7.86 billion as of June 30, 2025 to $12.57 billion as of June 30, 2026, which KLA attributes to strong demand driven by the AI infrastructure buildout.

KLA's 10-K: significant purchase commitments, primarily for material, services, supplies and asset purchases, were approximately $5.97 billion as of June 30, 2026, a majority due within the next 12 months; KLA says it increased its purchase commitments in part to secure the supply of key components.
